title: Memory Without Curation: Learning Multi-Stream Latent Memory for Robot Policies
abstract: arXiv:2610.14406v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: It is widely appreciated that robotic policies require long-term memory to perform complex tasks. However, directly conditioning policies on all past observations leaves policy learning susceptible to learning spurious shortcuts, and introduces large latency at policy deployment. As such, today's memory-augmented policies curate what to remember, either by retaining only recent frames, selected keyframes, or textual summaries, or by learning latent representations of the visual stream alone. In this work, we propose an alternative approach IMPRINT, a policy-agnostic latent memory framework that augments vision-language-action (VLA) models with multi-stream memory without explicitly constraining what the policy should remember. IMPRINT compresses different streams into a latent memory that is updated incrementally at inference, enabling low latency. translated_title: 无需筛选的记忆：为机器人策略学习多流潜在记忆
translated_abstract: 人们普遍认为，机器人策略需要长期记忆才能执行复杂任务。然而，直接让策略依赖于所有过去的观测，会使策略学习容易学到虚假的捷径，并在策略部署时引入较大的延迟。因此，当今的增强记忆策略会对需要记住的内容进行筛选，要么只保留最近的帧、选定的关键帧或文本摘要，要么仅对视觉流学习潜在表示。在本工作中，我们提出了一种替代方法 IMPRINT，这是一个与策略无关的潜在记忆框架，通过多流记忆来增强视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，而无需显式约束策略应当记住什么。IMPRINT 将不同的流压缩到一个在推理时增量更新的潜在记忆中，从而实现低延迟。为避免捷径学习，IMPRINT 采用两阶段训练流程，首先监督……（原摘要在此处截断）
tldr: IMPRINT 是一个与策略无关的多流潜在记忆框架，通过在推理时增量更新的压缩潜在记忆为 VLA 模型提供长期记忆能力，避免了捷径学习的同时实现了低延迟部署。
en_tdlr: IMPRINT is a policy-agnostic latent memory framework that equips VLA models with long-term memory by compressing multiple streams into an incrementally updated latent memory, achieving low latency while avoiding shortcut learning.
